item.title: Chocolate Peppermint Sandwiches
item.description: Dark chocolate cookies with a cool peppermint cream and crushed candy canes rolled around the edge. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Marble
item.description: Swirls of vanilla and chocolate batter in every cupcake, so no two look alike. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Chewy Molasses Spice
item.description: Dark, chewy and crackled, with ginger, cinnamon and a hint of clove. Coarse sugar on the outside gives each one a sparkle and a crunch. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Nan-e Kermanshahi (Kermanshah Butter Cookies)
item.description: Rich, golden butter cookies from western Iran, traditionally made with the region's famous ghee, finished with sesame. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.
